def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]] if sep_cols else None

    def segments(n, separators):
        result, start = [], 0
        for p in separators + [n]:
            if start < p:
                result.append((start, p))
            start = p + 1
        return result

    row_blocks = segments(h, sep_rows)
    col_blocks = segments(w, sep_cols)
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(cell for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols) for cell in [grid[r][c]])
    colors = [color for color in counts if color != divider]
    marker = min(colors, key=lambda color: counts[color])
    background = max(colors, key=lambda color: counts[color])
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2 else background
             for c0, c1 in col_blocks] for r0, r1 in row_blocks]
